items.quote: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?
items.claim: Abraham asked God whether He would destroy the righteous along with the wicked

items.quote: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?
items.claim: Abraham asked whether God would spare the place if fifty righteous were found in the city
items.mechanism: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city

items.quote: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
items.claim: Abraham denied that God should slay the righteous along with the wicked

items.quote: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.
items.claim: The LORD promised to spare the place if fifty righteous are found in Sodom
items.mechanism: If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city
